/* 통합검색 (IntegratedSearchMapper.getIntegratedSearchJson) */ WITH RECURSIVE menu_tree AS ( SELECT m.menu_sn, m.up_menu_sn, 1 AS dep_level, m.menu_sn AS root_sn, m.menu_nm, m.menu_seq, (m.menu_sn::text) AS path, m.menu_nm::text AS path_nm, m.lang_se_cd FROM kids_own.TB_PP_M_MENU m WHERE m.use_yn = 'Y' AND m.up_menu_sn IS NULL AND m.task_se_cd = 'PP' AND m.menu_type_cd = 'U' UNION ALL SELECT c.menu_sn, c.up_menu_sn, p.dep_level + 1, p.root_sn, c.menu_nm, c.menu_seq, (p.path || ' > ' || c.menu_sn::text) AS path, (p.path_nm || ' > ' || c.menu_nm::text) AS path_nm, c.lang_se_cd FROM kids_own.TB_PP_M_MENU c JOIN menu_tree p ON c.up_menu_sn = p.menu_sn WHERE c.use_yn = 'Y' AND c.task_se_cd = 'PP' AND c.menu_type_cd = 'U' )
select COALESCE( jsonb_agg( jsonb_build_object( 'root_menu_sn', A.root_menu_sn, 'root_menu_nm', A.root_menu_nm, 'menu_sn', A.menu_sn, 'menu_nm', A.menu_nm, 'path', A.path, 'path_nm', A.path_nm, 'menu_url_addr', A.menu_url_addr, 'doc_sn', A.doc_sn, 'doc_ttl', A.doc_ttl, 'doc_cn', A.doc_cn ) ) FILTER (WHERE 1=1), '[]'::jsonb ) AS total_json_array ,COALESCE( jsonb_agg( jsonb_build_object( 'root_menu_sn', A.root_menu_sn, 'root_menu_nm', A.root_menu_nm, 'menu_sn', A.menu_sn, 'menu_nm', A.menu_nm, 'path', A.path, 'path_nm', A.path_nm, 'menu_url_addr', A.menu_url_addr, 'doc_sn', A.doc_sn, 'doc_ttl', A.doc_ttl, 'doc_cn', A.doc_cn ) ) FILTER (WHERE A.root_menu_nm = '주요업무'), '[]'::jsonb ) AS main_task_json_array ,COALESCE( jsonb_agg( jsonb_build_object( 'root_menu_sn', A.root_menu_sn, 'root_menu_nm', A.root_menu_nm, 'menu_sn', A.menu_sn, 'menu_nm', A.menu_nm, 'path', A.path, 'path_nm', A.path_nm, 'menu_url_addr', A.menu_url_addr, 'doc_sn', A.doc_sn, 'doc_ttl', A.doc_ttl, 'doc_cn', A.doc_cn ) ) FILTER (WHERE A.root_menu_nm = '정보공개'), '[]'::jsonb ) AS info_open_json_array ,COALESCE( jsonb_agg( jsonb_build_object( 'root_menu_sn', A.root_menu_sn, 'root_menu_nm', A.root_menu_nm, 'menu_sn', A.menu_sn, 'menu_nm', A.menu_nm, 'path', A.path, 'path_nm', A.path_nm, 'menu_url_addr', A.menu_url_addr, 'doc_sn', A.doc_sn, 'doc_ttl', A.doc_ttl, 'doc_cn', A.doc_cn ) ) FILTER (WHERE A.root_menu_nm = '기관소식'), '[]'::jsonb ) AS inst_news_json_array ,COALESCE( jsonb_agg( jsonb_build_object( 'root_menu_sn', A.root_menu_sn, 'root_menu_nm', A.root_menu_nm, 'menu_sn', A.menu_sn, 'menu_nm', A.menu_nm, 'path', A.path, 'path_nm', A.path_nm, 'menu_url_addr', A.menu_url_addr, 'doc_sn', A.doc_sn, 'doc_ttl', A.doc_ttl, 'doc_cn', A.doc_cn ) ) FILTER (WHERE A.root_menu_nm = '기관소개'), '[]'::jsonb ) AS inst_intro_json_array FROM( SELECT tm.root_sn as root_menu_sn ,rm.menu_nm as root_menu_nm ,tm.menu_sn ,tm.menu_nm ,tm.path ,tm.path_nm ,dm.menu_url_addr ,mp.pst_sn::text as doc_sn ,mp.pst_ttl as doc_ttl ,mp.pst_cn as doc_cn FROM kids_own.tb_pp_m_pst mp INNER JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_d_menu dm ON ( /* ex) /pp/ko/board/general/BBS_COM_005 */ mp.bbs_id = substring(dm.menu_url_addr FROM position('/general/' in dm.menu_url_addr) + length('/general/')) or /* ex) /pp/ko/board/gallery/BBS_GAL_001 */ mp.bbs_id = substring(dm.menu_url_addr FROM position('/gallery/' in dm.menu_url_addr) + length('/gallery/')) or /* ex) /pp/ko/board/video/BBS_VDO_001 */ mp.bbs_id = substring(dm.menu_url_addr FROM position('/video/' in dm.menu_url_addr) + length('/video/')) ) INNER JOIN menu_tree tm ON tm.menu_sn = dm.menu_sn INNER JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_m_menu rm ON rm.menu_sn = tm.root_sn WHERE mp.pst_ttl like '%' || #{searchText} || '%' OR mp.pst_cn like '%' || #{searchText} || '%' UNION ALL SELECT tm.root_sn as root_menu_sn ,rm.menu_nm as root_menu_nm ,tm.menu_sn ,tm.menu_nm ,tm.path ,tm.path_nm ,dm.menu_url_addr ,cms.conts_sn::text as doc_sn ,cms.conts_ttl as doc_ttl ,cms.conts_cn as doc_cn FROM kids_own.tb_pp_m_conts cms INNER JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_d_menu dm ON /* ex) cms0006 /pp/ko/cms/CmsPage/cms0016 */ cms.conts_sn = substring(dm.menu_url_addr FROM position('/CmsPage/' in dm.menu_url_addr) + length('/CmsPage/')) INNER JOIN menu_tree tm ON tm.menu_sn = dm.menu_sn INNER JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_m_menu rm ON rm.menu_sn = tm.root_sn WHERE cms.conts_ttl like '%' || #{searchText} || '%' OR cms.conts_cn like '%' || #{searchText} || '%' ) A ORDER BY 1 ASC
